searchText: Next App Builders <> Core Devs Twitter Space tomorrow at 7PM UTC It would be great if you could join as a speaker to share your perspective and let app builders know they’re being heard This is a chance to hear directly from teams to understand how they’re using the protocol, and discuss where core development can support the app layer If you have any questions about the space, please don't hesitate to reach out: tg jchaskin signal chaz.50 https://x.com/i/spaces/1eaJbWdPdZdxX/peek Besu pectra testnet release https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/releases/tag/25.2.0 **ACDE in ~15 min** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1271 Stream: https://youtube.com/live/N90-qDkUPAo Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/releases/tag/v25.2.0 has been released for Holesky/Sepolia Pectra https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/releases/tag/v1.15.1 is the Geth testnet Pectra release. ACDE recap is up on EthMagicians 🧙‍♂️ https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/all-core-devs-execution-acde-205-february-13-2025/22828/ In the spirit of "giving ppl time to review things before ACD", would anyone oppose tweaking the Fusaka dates from March 13 to March 10 and March 27 to March 24? This way, we have a deadline of Monday for the `PFI` submissions and client teams sharing their PoVs, which gives everyone 2ish days to review things before ACD. Can we publish samilar timeline for Amsterdam in April? Yes, but maybe we can use events rather than dates? e.g. No `PFI` past client testnet releases, `CFI` happens around mainnet activation, etc? https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/pectra-upgrade-client-releases-for-holesky-sepolia-testnets/22857

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
In the spirit of "giving ppl time to review things before ACD", would anyone oppose tweaking the Fusaka dates from March 13 to March 10 and March 27 to March 24? 

This way, we have a deadline of Monday for the `PFI` submissions and client teams sharing their PoVs, which gives everyone 2ish days to review things before ACD.

excerpts.content: Can we publish samilar timeline for Amsterdam in April?

e.g. No `PFI` past client testnet releases, `CFI` happens around mainnet activation, etc?
